en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with advanced measurement techniques in case analytical methods (GC, LC, IR, UV-VIS), together with suitable sample preparation, to teach students to interpret measured data from various analyzes.

en.content: 1.Sample preparation for separation analyzes (allowance 0/2)2.Evaluation and interpretation of analytical methods (allowance 0/2)3.Chromatographic determination of tartaric and malic acids in wine (allowance 0/2)4.Determination of selected volatile compounds by gas chromatography (allowance 0/2)5.Spectrophotometric determination of antioxidant activity (allowance 0/2)6.Determination of residual sugars in wine (allowance 0/2)7.Wine analysis by infrared spectrometry (allowance 0/2)8.Calibration of analytical methods (allowance 0/2)9.Evaluation of the authenticity of fruit juices (allowance 0/2)10.Measurement of food dyes (allowance 0/2)11.Practical exam No. 1 (allowance 0/2)12.Practical exam No. 2 (allowance 0/2)
